title: 病理與檢驗醫學
intro: 組織病理、細胞學、分子病理與臨床檢驗判讀。 本科程序庫由課程工序生成，並標示為模板生成。
introEn: Histopathology, cytology, molecular pathology and clinical laboratory interpretation. This library is generated from the course steps and labelled as template-generated.

procedures.title: 組織處理與 H&E 染色
procedures.patient: 依課程「組織處理與 H&E 染色」設定的虛擬情境：固定、脫水、包埋、切片與染色。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Tissue processing and H&E staining": Fixation, dehydration, embedding, sectioning and staining. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
